info.title: Envoi Muse read-only feasibility API
info.description: Current staging API for checking one owner-enrolled Muse agent identity and a content-free summary of its pending work. Both operations are reads with no server-side state change. This is a five-minute, owner-initiated connection probe, not a durable Muse connector, OAuth account link, message reader, wake mechanism, or send API. An Envoi owner creates/reconnects the Muse identity in Envoi and enters the one-time probe bearer through Muse's secure connector credential flow. The credential cannot be refreshed by the connector; another probe requires a new owner-approved reconnect.

servers.description: Isolated Envoi staging. Verify /health releaseSha before a hosted test.

get.description: Read-only. Resolves agent and inbox from the bearer credential; no caller-supplied agent or inbox selector. The documented success shape below is for the five-minute agent_probe credential. It returns no message or file content.

get.summary: Count eligible work for the enrolled Muse agent
get.description: Read-only. Counts eligible work in the inbox bound to the bearer; it does not fetch message text, return work/case/message IDs, claim a lease, acknowledge work, or trigger Muse. A query-string inboxId is not an authorization selector. Ready means work eligible for a future claim, not that Muse has received or processed it.

403.description: The bound agent is not approved to receive messages

example.error: Agent is not approved to receive messages

probeBearer.description: Five-minute, opaque Envoi agent_probe credential issued once through owner enrollment/reconnect. Supply only in Authorization: Bearer, never a URL, prompt, tool argument, or log. No OAuth discovery or connector-side refresh exists for this probe.

leased.description: Already under an unexpired work lease.

retrying.description: Waiting for the server retry time.

oldestReadyAt.description: Oldest ready message delivery/creation time; null when none is ready.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired, revoked, paused, or otherwise invalid credential
